approach: Give the producer the information it lacked and keep what it says. (1) Add an optional, nullable `no_change` outcome to the producer's structured output (`ProducerOutput`, serde(default)): kind `already_done` | `blocked` | `gave_up`, plus a detail (evidence, blocker or reason). (2) Add a matching `NoChange` to the kept `ProducerReport` (serde(default), skipped when absent, so old records parse and write back byte-identically); `redact_report` redacts the detail and carries it over. (3) The Rust-built producer brief gets one short section after the existing "fails as an empty candidate" paragraph: that run still fails, but the `no_change` outcome becomes its recorded reason, so set it whenever the tree is left unchanged. (4) `candidate_stage` builds its empty-diff reason with a pure `no_change_reason(report, gaps, kept_in)`: with an outcome, "the producer made no change; it reported <kind>: <detail>"; with a report and no outcome, "the producer made no change and reported no reason: the report's no_change field was empty"; with no report, a third sentence. The gaps suffix stays as it is. The job still fails exactly as before; only the recorded reason changes. No admission, gate or check is added, so there is no refusal rule and no refused-readings share. Root cause (CHANGELOG and D171): the producer was never asked for a no-change outcome and Athena dropped the report it had when the diff was empty, so an empty diff was a bare failure. Answers to the round-2 findings: (1, 2) criterion 7's demonstration now sets fails_without and a seam (below). (3) crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs is forced, not optional: the only other `ProducerReport {` literal outside the type and its builder is the test helper at reading.rs:3862 (searched crates/; the others are records.rs:780, the definition, and run/mod.rs:2529, a deliverable). A struct literal missing the new field does not compile under `cargo clippy --all-targets`, and criterion 4 requires the new field on ProducerReport, so no design avoids touching that line; the edit is one token (`no_change: None`). (4, 5) docs/decisions.md and docs/decision-links.toml are forced by the deliverable candidate.rs: `[[governs]] D08` lists candidate.rs (docs/decision-links.toml:212-217), and `decision_gate` (crates/athena-core/src/run/checks.rs:21-52) closes a job that touches it unless the change adds a decision-log entry and a matching [[link]] older D08; its own message says so (checks.rs:46-49). The precedent is D160 (docs/decisions.md:4435-4454, 'Amends D08 in prose only … stands', link line 4443). Dropping them would make the job close at the decision gate, so they stay, as the smallest entry (one decision, one link). No other file is added.

Nothing in crates/athena-core/src/admission.rs, run/checks.rs, the send-back conditions in producer.rs (488-495) or crates/athena-gate is touched.
